sources.notes: Inspected 2026-11-13. robots.txt (User-agent: *) only disallows /application/, /development/, /externals/, /temporary/: the dictionary is allowed. Letter pages ?lettre=A..Z list 100 Duala headwords per page (div.word-item > div.word-dua > a) with pagination ?mboa_page=N; the French column (div.word-fr) is empty on list pages, so each word page is opened (article.mboa-u-dict-sheet: .mboa-u-sheet-word = Duala, .mboa-u-sheet-translation strong = French).
